description: When the traveler is ready to book: returns checkout_url, the one link to send them. It opens "Book your trip" on seatac.co, which lists every part to book, in any order, each paid on its own: the trip itself (the cruise or event tickets, with a partner), the flight (with a partner), the hotel (on seatac.co's room page), and the rides (by licensed partner operators, paid together in one card payment on seatac.co), timed to the flight, hotel and sailing. A ride waits only for what it connects to: to or from Seatac for its flight, to or from the hotel for the hotel, to or from the pier for the sailing (booked, booked elsewhere or not needed all unlock it); a waiting ride says so in waits_for. booking_order lists each part, its items and a suggested next. This tool books and charges nothing; the traveler confirms and pays on seatac.co.
name: get_checkout_link
title: Get the booking link
